Tooltip_BulletPressTool.en: Heavy reusable press used to assemble ammunition. Must be carried with both hands.
Tooltip_BulletPressTool.ch: 可重複使用的重型彈藥裝配壓床。必須用雙手搬運。
Tooltip_BulletPressTool.cn: 可重复使用的重型弹药装配压床。必须用双手搬运。

Tooltip_GunCleaningTools.en: Consumable supplies for maintaining and repairing firearms. Contains 10 uses.
Tooltip_GunCleaningTools.ch: 用於保養與維修槍械的耗材。可使用 10 次。
Tooltip_GunCleaningTools.cn: 用于保养和维修枪械的消耗品。可使用 10 次。

Tooltip_GunToolsKit.en: Specialized tools used to salvage parts from firearms and attachments. Contains 10 uses.
Tooltip_GunToolsKit.ch: 用於從槍械與配件回收零件的專用工具。可使用 10 次。
Tooltip_GunToolsKit.cn: 用于从枪械和配件中回收零件的专用工具。可使用 10 次。

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_BowlOfGlaze.en: Enough for four pieces. Brush it on greenware, then fire it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_BowlOfGlaze.ch: 足夠塗四件. 刷在坯體上, 然後燒製.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_BowlOfGlaze.cn: 足够涂四件. 刷在坯体上, 然后烧制.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ClayJarGlazedUnfired.en: Coated and drying. The glaze only becomes glass in the kiln.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ClayJarGlazedUnfired.ch: 已上釉, 正在陰乾. 釉料要進窯爐才會熔成玻璃.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ClayJarGlazedUnfired.cn: 已上釉, 正在阴干. 釉料要进窑炉才会熔成玻璃.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoCeramicPainting.en: Colour on fired clay, one coat at a time.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoCeramicPainting.ch: 在燒好的陶坯上上色, 一層一層來.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoCeramicPainting.cn: 在烧好的陶坯上上色, 一层一层来.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoFoundryMag.en: Crucibles, molds and what to do with a drawer full of scrap jewellery.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoFoundryMag.ch: 坩堝, 模具, 以及一整抽屜廢首飾的用處.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoFoundryMag.cn: 坩埚, 模具, 以及一整抽屉废首饰的用处.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoPorcelainMag.en: The white body, the long firing, and how to glaze what comes out.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoPorcelainMag.ch: 白色瓷胎, 長時間燒製, 以及出窯後要怎麼上釉.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_HydeCoPorcelainMag.cn: 白色瓷胎, 长时间烧制, 以及出窑后要怎么上釉.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ModelingClayMaster.en: A modeling-clay master. Set it in a casting frame and pour plaster around it to make a slip-casting mold. It is not fired itself.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ModelingClayMaster.ch: 塑形黏土原模. 把它放進鑄造框, 在四周灌入石膏, 就能翻製泥漿鑄造模具. 原模本身不需燒製.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ModelingClayMaster.cn: 塑形黏土原型. 把它放进铸造框, 在四周灌入石膏, 就能制作注浆铸造模具. 原型本身不需要烧制.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PlantPotUnfired.en: Greenware. It will slump in the rain and fall apart in water until it has been fired.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PlantPotUnfired.ch: 坯體. 在燒製之前, 淋雨會塌陷, 泡水會散開.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PlantPotUnfired.cn: 坯体. 在烧制之前, 淋雨会塌陷, 泡水会散开.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainBarMold.en: Fired far hotter than earthenware. It will not crack when you pour.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainBarMold.ch: 燒成溫度遠高於陶器. 澆鑄時不會裂開.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainBarMold.cn: 烧成温度远高于陶器. 浇铸时不会裂开.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainBarMoldUnfir.en: Porcelain, shaped but not yet fired. Brittle until it sees a kiln.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainBarMoldUnfir.ch: 已經塑形但還沒燒製的瓷坯. 進窯爐之前都很脆.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainBarMoldUnfir.cn: 已经塑形但还没烧制的瓷坯. 进窑炉之前都很脆.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainChunk.en: A heavy piece of a smashed sink or toilet. Vitreous china: whiter and finer than ordinary pottery clay. Crush it into shards.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainChunk.ch: 從砸碎的洗手台或馬桶取下的沉重塊料. 玻化瓷: 比一般陶土更白更細. 可以敲碎成碎片.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainChunk.cn: 从砸碎的洗手池或马桶取下的沉重块料. 玻化瓷: 比普通陶土更白更细. 可以敲碎成碎片.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainClay.en: A workable white body. Shapes and fires like clay, but comes out of the kiln bright white instead of terracotta.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainClay.ch: 可塑的白色坯土. 成形與燒製都和黏土一樣, 但出窯後是亮白色, 而不是紅陶色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainClay.cn: 可塑的白色坯土. 成形与烧制都和黏土一样, 但出窑后是亮白色, 而不是红陶色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucible.en: Fired hotter and cleaner than earthenware, so it takes the metals a ceramic crucible cannot - gold, silver, brass, copper and aluminium. Iron and steel are still the ceramic one's job.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucible.ch: 燒成溫度比陶器更高也更潔淨, 因此能盛裝陶瓷坩堝盛不住的金屬 - 金, 銀, 黃銅, 銅與鋁. 鐵與鋼仍舊得交給陶瓷坩堝.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucible.cn: 烧成温度比陶器更高也更洁净, 因此能盛装陶瓷坩埚盛不住的金属 - 金, 银, 黄铜, 铜和铝. 铁和钢仍旧得交给陶瓷坩埚.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucibleFull.en: Holding molten metal. Keep filling it, then pour it into an ingot mold at the furnace.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucibleFull.ch: 裝著熔融金屬. 持續裝滿後, 在熔爐旁倒入鑄錠模具.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucibleFull.cn: 盛着熔融金属. 持续装满后, 在熔炉旁倒入铸锭模具.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucibleUnfi.en: Shaped porcelain, still soft. Fire it before it is any use.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucibleUnfi.ch: 已塑形但還軟的瓷坯. 燒製後才派得上用場.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainCrucibleUnfi.cn: 已塑形但还软的瓷坯. 烧制后才派得上用场.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainIngotMold.en: Fired far hotter than earthenware. It will not crack when you pour.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainIngotMold.ch: 燒成溫度遠高於陶器. 澆鑄時不會裂開.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainIngotMold.cn: 烧成温度远高于陶器. 浇铸时不会裂开.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainIngotMoldUnf.en: Porcelain, shaped but not yet fired. Brittle until it sees a kiln.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainIngotMoldUnf.ch: 已經塑形但還沒燒製的瓷坯. 進窯爐之前都很脆.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainIngotMoldUnf.cn: 已经塑形但还没烧制的瓷坯. 进窑炉之前都很脆.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainPowder.en: Finely ground china. Mixed with water and a little clay it makes porcelain slip.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainPowder.ch: 磨得極細的瓷粉末. 加水與少量黏土調和就成為瓷泥漿.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainPowder.cn: 磨得极细的瓷粉末. 加水和少量黏土调和就成为瓷泥浆.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainShards.en: Sharp white fragments. Grind them into porcelain powder.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainShards.ch: 鋒利的白色碎片. 可研磨成瓷粉.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_PorcelainShards.cn: 锋利的白色碎片. 可研磨成瓷粉.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CastNonFerrous.en: Pour full crucibles into an ingot mold. The mold is kept.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CastNonFerrous.ch: 把裝滿的坩堝澆入鑄錠模具. 模具會保留下來.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CastNonFerrous.cn: 把装满的坩埚浇入铸锭模具. 模具会保留下来.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CrushPorcelain.en: Break a chunk of china down into shards.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CrushPorcelain.ch: 把一塊瓷器敲碎成碎片.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_CrushPorcelain.cn: 把一块瓷器敲碎成碎片.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_EmptyPot.en: Tip the soil back out. The pot is left clean.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_EmptyPot.ch: 把土倒回去. 花盆就空出來了.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_EmptyPot.cn: 把土倒回去. 花盆就空出来了.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FillPot.en: A pot needs soil in it before anything will grow.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FillPot.ch: 花盆要先裝土, 植物才長得起來.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FillPot.cn: 花盆要先装土, 植物才长得起来.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FireGlazed.en: The glaze melts to a glass skin. A glazed jar seals like a canning jar.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FireGlazed.ch: 釉料熔成一層玻璃薄膜. 上釉的罐子能像玻璃罐一樣密封.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FireGlazed.cn: 釉料熔成一层玻璃薄膜. 上釉的罐子能像玻璃罐一样密封.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelain.en: Needs a kiln, something to light it, and fuel.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelain.ch: 需要窯爐, 點火用具與燃料.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelain.cn: 需要窑炉, 点火用具和燃料.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainB.en: A long, hot firing. Porcelain needs it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainB.ch: 一次漫長的高溫燒製. 瓷器就需要這樣的火.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainB.cn: 一次漫长的高温烧制. 瓷器就需要这样的火.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainC.en: Fire the crucible in a kiln. Needs fuel and something to light it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainC.ch: 在窯爐中燒製坩堝. 需要燃料與點火用具.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainC.cn: 在窑炉中烧制坩埚. 需要燃料与点火用具.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainI.en: A long, hot firing. Porcelain needs it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainI.ch: 一次漫長的高溫燒製. 瓷器就需要這樣的火.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_FirePorcelainI.cn: 一次漫长的高温烧制. 瓷器就需要这样的火.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Glaze.en: Brush glaze onto an unfired jar. Fired, it comes out watertight and safe to preserve food in.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Glaze.ch: 在未燒製的罐子上刷一層釉. 燒製之後就不透水, 可以安心用來保存食物.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Glaze.cn: 在未烧制的罐子上刷一层釉. 烧制之后就不透水, 可以安心用来保存食物.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrindPorcelain.en: Grind shards into a fine white powder.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrindPorcelain.ch: 把碎片磨成潔白的細粉.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrindPorcelain.cn: 把碎片研磨成洁白的细粉.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrogSlurry.en: Stir ceramic powder into a bucket holding at least 10 L of water. The same bucket ends up holding 10 L of grog slurry.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrogSlurry.ch: 把陶瓷粉攪進至少裝有 10 L 水的水桶. 同一個水桶最後會裝著 10 L 熟料漿.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GrogSlurry.cn: 把陶瓷粉搅进至少装有 10 L 水的水桶. 同一个水桶最后会装着 10 L 熟料浆.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GroggedSlip.en: Take a bucket holding 5 L of clay slip and stir in 5 L of grog slurry from any container. The slip bucket ends up holding 10 L of grogged slip. Pour off any slip above 5 L first - whatever is left in the bucket is thrown out with the mix.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GroggedSlip.ch: 取一桶裝有 5 L 泥漿的水桶, 再從任何容器倒入 5 L 熟料漿攪拌. 這桶泥漿最後會變成 10 L 熟料泥漿. 請先把超過 5 L 的泥漿倒掉 - 桶裡多出來的部分會跟著混料一起被丟棄.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_GroggedSlip.cn: 取一桶装有 5 L 泥浆的水桶, 再从任意容器倒入 5 L 熟料浆搅拌. 这桶泥浆最后会变成 10 L 熟料泥浆. 请先把超过 5 L 的泥浆倒掉 - 桶里多出来的部分会跟着混料一起被丢弃.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_MakeGlaze.en: Slip and quicklime, mixed thin in a bowl. Quicklime is what makes it melt to glass.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_MakeGlaze.ch: 把泥漿與生石灰在碗裡調稀. 生石灰就是讓它熔成玻璃的關鍵.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_MakeGlaze.cn: 把泥浆与生石灰在碗里调稀. 生石灰就是让它熔成玻璃的关键.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintCoat.en: Repaint the coat of a painted ceramic gnome with one dab of paint. The hat keeps its colour - the crafting preview always shows a red hat, but your gnome keeps its own.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintCoat.ch: 只用一點油漆就能重新彩繪陶瓷侏儒的外套. 帽子會保留原本的顏色 - 製作預覽一律顯示紅色帽子, 但你的侏儒仍保有自己的帽色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintCoat.cn: 只用一点油漆就能重新彩绘陶瓷侏儒的外套. 帽子会保留原本的颜色 - 制作预览一律显示红色帽子, 但你的侏儒仍保有自己的帽色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintDeer.en: Paint the deer with a paintbrush and dabs of paint.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintDeer.ch: 用漆刷和幾點油漆為鹿上色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintDeer.cn: 用油漆刷和几点油漆为鹿上色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintEgg.en: Paint a fired ceramic egg with a paintbrush and one dab from a can of paint - the can sets the colour. Patterned eggs (speckled, striped, zigzag, squiggle, squiggle-and-dot) also take a dab of white.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintEgg.ch: 用漆刷與一罐油漆的一份塗料彩繪已燒製的陶瓷蛋 - 顏色由油漆罐決定. 帶圖紋的蛋 (斑點, 條紋, 之字紋, 波紋, 波紋點) 還要再用一份白色塗料.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintEgg.cn: 用油漆刷与一罐油漆的一份涂料彩绘已烧制的陶瓷蛋 - 颜色由油漆罐决定. 带图纹的蛋 (斑点, 条纹, 之字纹, 波纹, 波纹点) 还要再用一份白色涂料.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintFrog.en: Paint the frog in its natural colours with a paintbrush and a dab each of green, black and white paint. It becomes a Ceramic Pot Scrubber Frog.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintFrog.ch: 用漆刷和各一點綠色, 黑色與白色油漆, 把青蛙彩繪成自然的模樣. 完成後會變成陶瓷鍋刷 (青蛙造型).
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintFrog.cn: 用油漆刷和各一点绿色, 黑色与白色油漆, 把青蛙彩绘成自然的模样. 完成后会变成陶瓷锅刷 (青蛙造型).

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintJackOLant.en: Paint the jack o' lantern with a paintbrush and dabs of paint.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintJackOLant.ch: 用漆刷和幾點油漆為南瓜燈上色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintJackOLant.cn: 用油漆刷和几点油漆为南瓜灯上色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintPot.en: Any paint works, and the pot can be repainted as often as you like.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintPot.ch: 任何油漆都可以用, 花盆想重新上色幾次都行.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintPot.cn: 任何油漆都可以用, 花盆想重新上色多少次都行.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintStem.en: Repaint the stem of a painted ceramic mushroom with one dab of paint. The cap keeps its colour - the crafting preview always shows a red cap, but your mushroom keeps its own.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintStem.ch: 用一點油漆為彩繪陶瓷蘑菇的菌柄重新上色. 菌傘會保留原本的顏色 - 製作預覽一律顯示紅色菌傘, 但你的蘑菇仍是自己的顏色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PaintStem.cn: 用一点油漆为彩绘陶瓷蘑菇的菌柄重新上色. 菌盖会保留原本的颜色 - 制作预览始终显示红色菌盖, 但你的蘑菇仍是自己的颜色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PlantPot.en: Throw a plant pot on the wheel. It still needs firing.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PlantPot.ch: 在陶輪上拉出一個花盆. 之後仍需燒製.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PlantPot.cn: 在陶轮上拉出一个花盆. 之后仍需要烧制.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PorcelainClay.en: Stiffens porcelain slip into a workable body. Beeswax, sand or dirt all bind it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PorcelainClay.ch: 把瓷泥漿收稠成可以塑形的坯體. 蜂蠟、沙子或泥土都能用來黏合.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PorcelainClay.cn: 把瓷泥浆收稠成可以塑形的坯体. 蜂蜡、沙子或泥土都能用来黏合.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PorcelainSlip.en: Mixed in the bucket you are holding. Fills it with ten litres of porcelain slip; anything already in the bucket is poured out first.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PorcelainSlip.ch: 在你手上的水桶裡調製. 會把水桶裝滿十公升瓷泥漿; 桶內原有的東西會先倒掉.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_PorcelainSlip.cn: 在你手持的水桶里调制. 会把水桶装满十升瓷泥浆; 桶内原有的东西会先倒掉.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Repot.en: Move the plant into a pot of your own. It keeps growing; only the pot changes.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Repot.ch: 把植物移進你自己的花盆. 它會繼續生長; 換掉的只有花盆.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Repot.cn: 把植物移进你自己的花盆. 它会继续生长; 换掉的只有花盆.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.en: Shape the white body on a pottery surface. It fires white, so there is nothing to paint.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.ch: 在陶藝檯面上塑出白色坯體. 燒成後本來就是白的, 不需要再上色.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.cn: 在陶艺台面上塑出白色坯体. 烧成后本来就是白的, 不需要再上色.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.en: Press porcelain into a bar mold.
Throw a crucible from porcelain clay. It has to be fired before it will hold anything molten.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.ch: 用瓷土拉坯製成坩堝. 必須先燒製, 才能盛裝熔融物.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.cn: 用瓷土拉坯制成坩埚. 必须先烧制, 才能盛装熔融物.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.en: Press porcelain into an ingot mold.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.ch: 把瓷土壓製成鑄錠模具.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_ShapePorcelain.cn: 把瓷土压制成铸锭模具.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Slip.en: Stir clay into a bucket holding at least 8 L of water. The same bucket ends up holding 10 L of clay slip; pour it out and it is a plain bucket again.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Slip.ch: 把黏土攪進至少裝有 8 L 水的水桶. 同一個水桶最後會裝著 10 L 黏土泥漿; 倒掉之後又變回普通水桶.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Slip.cn: 把黏土搅进至少装有 8 L 水的水桶. 同一个水桶最后会装着 10 L 黏土泥浆; 倒掉之后又变回普通水桶.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmashDecoratio.en: Break a finished ceramic piece back into shards.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmashDecoratio.ch: 把完成的陶瓷成品打碎回碎片.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmashDecoratio.cn: 把完成的陶瓷成品砸碎回碎片.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmashPorcelain.en: Break a finished porcelain piece back into shards.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmashPorcelain.ch: 把燒製好的瓷器敲回碎片.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmashPorcelain.cn: 把烧制好的瓷器敲回碎片.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmeltNonFerrou.en: Melt scrap down into a porcelain crucible at a furnace. Keep adding until it is full, then cast it.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmeltNonFerrou.ch: 在熔爐旁把廢料熔進瓷坩堝裡. 持續添加到裝滿, 然後進行鑄造.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_SmeltNonFerrou.cn: 在熔炉旁把废料熔入瓷坩埚中. 持续添加直到装满, 然后进行铸造.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Unpot.en: Lift the plant out with its root ball. You get the pot back with its soil.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Unpot.ch: 連著根球把植物取出. 花盆會連同盆土一起歸還.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_Recipe_Unpot.cn: 连着根球把植物取出. 花盆会连同盆土一起归还.

Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ReclaimGreenware.en: Squash an unfired piece back into clay. Only works before it goes in the kiln - once fired, smash it for shards instead.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ReclaimGreenware.ch: 把未燒製的坯體壓回黏土. 只能在進窯爐前處理 - 一旦燒製完成, 就只能粉碎取得碎片.
Tooltip_HydeCoClay_ReclaimGreenware.cn: 把未烧制的坯体压回黏土. 只能在进窑炉前处理 - 一旦烧制完成, 就只能粉碎获取碎片.

Tooltip_DM_Relic_FlashingClaw.en: Artifact. A machete whose edge arrives before its gleam. Effects: Quick +80%% combat speed, Impact damage +44%%, Force +0.8, Knockdown +24%%.
Tooltip_DM_Relic_FlashingClaw.ch: 神器. 一把刃鋒先於寒光抵達的砍刀. 效果: 迅疾 +80%% 戰鬥速度, 衝擊傷害 +44%%, 推力 +0.8, 擊倒 +24%%.
Tooltip_DM_Relic_FlashingClaw.cn: 神器. 一把刃锋先于寒光抵达的砍刀. 效果: 迅疾 +80%% 战斗速度, 冲击伤害 +44%%, 推力 +0.8, 击倒 +24%%.

Tooltip_DM_Relic_Pummeler.en: Artifact. A short bat that lands three blows in the space of one. Effects: Quick +80%% combat speed, Impact damage +32%%, Force +1.6, Knockdown +48%%.
Tooltip_DM_Relic_Pummeler.ch: 神器. 一支短球棒, 在一擊的時間內落下三下重擊. 效果: 迅疾 +80%% 戰鬥速度, 衝擊傷害 +32%%, 擊退 +1.6, 擊倒 +48%%.
Tooltip_DM_Relic_Pummeler.cn: 神器. 一支短球棒, 在一击的时间内落下三下重击. 效果: 迅疾 +80%% 战斗速度, 冲击伤害 +32%%, 击退 +1.6, 击倒 +48%%.

Tooltip_GSEPC_FieldGrade.en: Old grade. Repair effectiveness: 70%% of Regular. Each part provides about 35 condition-equivalent repair instead of the normal 50. Requires Mechanics 6, Metalworking 4 and Electrical 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_FieldGrade.ch: 老舊等級. 修復效果為普通級的 70%%. 每個零件約可修復 35 點狀態, 而非一般的 50 點. 需要技工 6、金工 4 與電工 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_FieldGrade.cn: 老式等级. 修复效果为普通级的 70%%. 每个零件约可修复 35 点状态, 而非通常的 50 点. 需要技工 6、金工 4 与电工 4.

Tooltip_GSEPC_Reconditioned.en: Performance grade. Repair effectiveness: 140%% of Regular. Each part provides about 70 condition-equivalent repair instead of the normal 50. Requires Mechanics 8, Metalworking 5 and Electrical 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_Reconditioned.ch: 高性能等級. 修復效果為普通級的 140%%. 每個零件約可修復 70 點狀態, 而非一般的 50 點. 需要技工 8、金工 5 與電工 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_Reconditioned.cn: 高级等级. 修复效果为普通级的 140%%. 每个零件约可修复 70 点状态, 而非通常的 50 点. 需要技工 8、金工 5 与电工 4.

Tooltip_GSEPC_ServiceGrade.en: Regular grade. Repair effectiveness: 100%% baseline. Each part provides the normal 50 condition-equivalent repair. Requires Mechanics 7, Metalworking 5 and Electrical 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_ServiceGrade.ch: 普通等級. 修復效果為基準的 100%%. 每個零件可修復一般的 50 點狀態. 需要技工 7、金工 5 與電工 4.
Tooltip_GSEPC_ServiceGrade.cn: 普通等级. 修复效果为基准的 100%%. 每个零件可修复通常的 50 点状态. 需要技工 7、金工 5 与电工 4.

Grenade_Launcher_Tooltip.en: Under-barrel grenade launcher for compatible rifles.
Grenade_Launcher_Tooltip.ch: 可安裝於相容步槍的下掛式榴彈發射器.
Grenade_Launcher_Tooltip.cn: 可安装于兼容步枪的下挂式榴弹发射器.
Grenade_Launcher_Tooltip._note: #326: Grenade_Launcher_Tooltip。Under-barrel 沿用既有 Tooltip_weapon_Underbarrel「下掛配件」的「下掛/下挂」；grenade launcher 沿用 Base.M320_GL「榴彈發射器」。compatible 依語別分用 CH 相容 / CN 兼容。

Handguard_Tooltip.en: Handguard attachment that can unlock compatible accessory slots.
Handguard_Tooltip.ch: 護木配件, 可解鎖相容的配件插槽.
Handguard_Tooltip.cn: 护木配件, 可解锁兼容的配件插槽.
Handguard_Tooltip._note: #326: Handguard_Tooltip。Handguard 沿用倉庫大量既有的「護木/护木」（IGUI_Handguard、Tooltip_weapon_HandguardItem「護木配件」）；accessory slots 譯為配件插槽，unlock 保留「解鎖/解锁」的機制語意（非「開啟」）。

Mount_Tooltip.en: Mount or rail required by compatible optics and accessories.
Mount_Tooltip.ch: 相容光學瞄具與配件所需的托架或導軌.
Mount_Tooltip.cn: 兼容光学瞄具与配件所需的托架或导轨.
Mount_Tooltip._note: #326: compatible 依語系分流：CH 相容、CN 兼容（IGUI_Inspect_Mag_* 既有慣例）；rail 取 CH 導軌／CN 导轨（Tooltip_Recipe_ScopeAdapter「皮卡汀尼導軌」）；標點沿用 Tooltip 檔的半形「.」。

Stock_Tooltip.en: Stock attachment that changes handling and recoil.
Stock_Tooltip.ch: 槍托配件, 會改變操控性與後座力.
Stock_Tooltip.cn: 枪托配件, 会改变操控性与后坐力.
Stock_Tooltip._note: #326: stock=槍托/枪托；recoil 取 CH「後座力」(Tooltip_ForeGrip、Tooltip_Integral_Bipod) 與 CN「后坐力」；標點沿用 Tooltip 檔的半形「, 」與「.」。

Tooltip_Canon.ch: 適用於相容槍械的槍口配件.
Tooltip_Canon.cn: 适用于兼容枪械的枪口配件.

Tooltip_GrenadeAmmo.ch: 適用於相容榴彈發射器的榴彈彈藥.

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.en: Choose if you want to see the posture hud. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[Enabled]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.ch: 選擇是否顯示姿勢HUD. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[啟用]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_ShowHud_too.cn: 选择是否显示姿势HUD. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[启用]

UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.en: A higher value will increase the Hud transparency. <LINE>Recommended: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.ch: 數值越高, HUD的透明度越高. <LINE>推薦設定: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%%]
UI_options_SMP_LethalStealth_Transparenc.cn: 数值越高, HUD的透明度越高. <LINE>推荐设置: <RGB:0,1,0> <SPACE>[35%%]

UI_ForgedByCombat_Tooltip_NextLevel.ch: 下一級: %1 次擊殺 (還差%2)
UI_ForgedByCombat_Tooltip_NextLevel.cn: 下一级: %1 次击杀 (还差%2)

UI_ForgedByCombat_description.en: Fighting skill honed through melee combat. Each zombie killed sharpens your instincts and improves your attack speed, damage, and critical chance.
UI_ForgedByCombat_description.ch: 透過近身搏鬥磨練戰鬥技巧. 每消滅一個殭屍都會提升你的直覺, 提高攻速, 傷害和暴擊率
UI_ForgedByCombat_description.cn: 通过近身搏斗磨练战斗技巧. 每消灭一个僵尸都会提升你的直觉, 提高攻速, 伤害和暴击率

Tooltip_CannabisEffects.en: Relaxes the mind and eases stress.
Tooltip_CannabisEffects.ch: 放鬆心神, 緩解壓力.
Tooltip_CannabisEffects.cn: 放松心神, 缓解压力.

UI_gain_smoker.en: I'm really craving a cigarette right about now...
UI_gain_smoker.ch: 我現在真的很想來根菸…
UI_gain_smoker.cn: 我现在真的很想来根烟…

UI_lost_stoner.en: Been a while since I last smoked some weed...

UI_regain_smoker.en: I feel like having a cigarette...

UI_speech_seed1.en: Do I see a seed in this bud?
UI_speech_seed1.ch: 這朵花蕾裡是不是有顆種子?
UI_speech_seed1.cn: 这朵花蕾里是不是有颗种子?

UI_trait_stonerdesc.en: Does not get sleepy or hungry from smoking pot, but needs more for the same effect.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.ch: 抽大麻不會想睡也不會餓, 但要抽更多才能達到同樣效果.
UI_trait_stonerdesc.cn: 抽大麻不会想睡也不会饿, 但要抽更多才能达到同样效果.

UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.en: You were hooked up on benzos before the apocalypse.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.ch: 末日之前你就對苯二氮平類藥物成癮了.
UI_KD_BenzoAddict_desc.cn: 末日之前你就对苯二氮䓬类药物成瘾了.

UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.en: You had brain damaged. Focusing is now harder.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.ch: 你的大腦受過損傷. 現在更難集中注意力.
UI_KD_BrainDamaged_desc.cn: 你的大脑受过损伤. 现在更难集中注意力.

UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.en: You are interested in drugs and made a little too much researches.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.ch: 你對毒品很感興趣, 而且研究得有點過頭.
UI_KD_DrugKnowledge_desc.cn: 你对毒品很感兴趣, 而且研究得有点过头.

UI_KD_Huffer_desc.en: You like to sniff things that shouldn't be...
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.ch: 你喜歡吸一些本來不該吸的東西…
UI_KD_Huffer_desc.cn: 你喜欢吸一些本来不该吸的东西…

UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.en: You took the habit of consumming low stimulant a little too much...
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.ch: 你養成了服用輕度興奮劑的習慣, 而且用得有點多…
UI_KD_LightStimulantsDependant_desc.cn: 你养成了服用轻度兴奋剂的习惯, 而且用得有点多…

UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.en: Idk how but you're addicted to raw opium
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.ch: 不知怎麼的, 你對生鴉片上癮了
UI_KD_OpiumAddict_desc.cn: 不知怎么的, 你对生鸦片上瘾了

UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.ch: 你已離不開甲基安非他命.
UI_KD_Tweaker_desc.cn: 你已离不开甲基苯丙胺.

UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.en: Your skeleton is indestructable. Doesn't mean you are.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.ch: 你的骨骼堅不可摧. 但你可不是.
UI_item_AdamantiumSkeletonTooltip.cn: 你的骨骼坚不可摧. 但你可不是.

UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.en: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not real.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.ch: 看不見不代表它不存在.
UI_item_PlotArmorTooltip.cn: 看不见不代表它不存在.

UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.en: If you have the Celerity trait you will be notified when dodging a dragdown.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神速特質, 閃避被拖倒時會收到通知.
UI_options_CelerityDodgeTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神速特质, 闪避被拖倒时会收到通知.

UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.en: If you have the Deadshot trait you will be notified when ammo is restored.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.ch: 若你擁有神射手特質, 恢復彈藥時會收到通知.
UI_options_DeadshotAmmoTooltip.cn: 若你拥有神射手特质, 恢复弹药时会收到通知.

UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.en: If you have the Invisibility trait you will be notified when triggering an assassination.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.ch: 若你擁有隱形特質, 觸發暗殺時會收到通知.
UI_options_InvisibilityAssassinateToolti.cn: 若你拥有隐形特质, 触发暗杀时会收到通知.

UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.en: If you have the Adamantium trait you will be notified when claws are extended.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.ch: 若你擁有亞德曼合金特質, 伸出利爪時會收到通知.
UI_options_PopClawsTooltip.cn: 若你拥有艾德曼合金特质, 伸出利爪时会收到通知.

UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.en: If you have the Telekenisis trait you will be notified when pushing a zombie back.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.ch: 若你擁有念力特質, 推開殭屍時會收到通知.
UI_options_TelekinesisPushTooltip.cn: 若你拥有念力特质, 推开僵尸时会收到通知.

UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.en:
Start with an indestructable adamantium skeleton.
Pop adamantium claws when attacking unarmed.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.ch:
開局即擁有堅不可摧的亞德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻擊時彈出亞德曼合金爪.
UI_trait_AdamantiumDesc.cn:
开局即拥有坚不可摧的艾德曼合金骨骼.
徒手攻击时弹出艾德曼合金爪.

UI_trait_CelerityDesc.en:
Superhuman speed and reaction time.
Faster combat and recovery animations.
Faster movement and timed actions.
Chance to dodge zombie attacks.
Dextrous
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.ch:
超乎常人的速度與反應.
戰鬥與恢復動作更快.
移動與計時動作更快.
有機率閃避殭屍攻擊.
眼疾手快
UI_trait_CelerityDesc.cn:
超乎常人的速度与反应.
战斗与恢复动作更快.
移动与计时动作更快.
有几率闪避僵尸攻击.
眼疾手快

UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.en:
One shot. One kill. Every time.
Firearms degrade more slowly, and may restore ammo when fired.
Desensitized
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.ch:
一槍一命, 從不落空.
槍械磨損更慢, 射擊時可能恢復彈藥.
麻木不仁
目光銳利
UI_trait_DeadshotDesc.cn:
一枪一命, 从不落空.
枪械磨损更慢, 射击时可能恢复弹药.
麻木不仁
目光锐利

UI_trait_EideticDesc.en:
Perfect recall and comprehension.
Gain skill levels by reading skill books.
Automatically know all recipes.
Fast Learner
Fast Reader
UI_trait_EideticDesc.ch:
記憶與理解力完美無缺.
閱讀技能書即可提升技能等級.
自動學會所有配方.
學習神速
閱讀神速
UI_trait_EideticDesc.cn:
记忆与理解力完美无缺.
阅读技能书即可提升技能等级.
自动学会所有配方.
学习神速
阅读神速

UI_trait_FlightDesc.en:
Sky roads are faster than walking.
Double tap the vehicle key to toggle flight mode. Page Up/Down to change elevation.
Constant feather fall.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.ch:
走天路比走路快.
連按兩次載具鍵切換飛行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 調整高度.
永久羽落效果.
UI_trait_FlightDesc.cn:
走天路比走路快.
连按两次车辆键切换飞行模式. 用 Page Up/Down 调整高度.
永久羽落效果.

UI_trait_HammerDesc.en:
Explosive hammer strikes.
Will blow the pants right off you.
Works with blunt weapons.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.ch:
爆炸性的錘擊.
威力大到能把你的褲子轟飛.
適用於鈍器.
UI_trait_HammerDesc.cn:
爆炸性的锤击.
威力大到能把你的裤子轰飞.
适用于钝器.

UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.en:
Become invisible while sneaking.
Assassinate enemies while invisible.
Graceful
Inconspicuous
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.ch:
潛行時變得隱形.
隱形時可暗殺敵人.
身輕如燕
毫不起眼
UI_trait_InvisibilityDesc.cn:
潜行时变得隐形.
隐形时可暗杀敌人.
身轻如燕
毫不起眼

UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.en:
Shoot fricken' laser beams out of your eyes.
Wear any eyewear to activate. Equip from the hotbar, then point and shoot.
Eagle Eyed
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.ch:
從眼睛射出該死的雷射光束.
戴上任何眼部裝備即可啟用. 從快捷欄裝備後瞄準射擊.
目光銳利
UI_trait_LaserEyesDesc.cn:
从眼睛射出该死的激光光束.
戴上任何眼部装备即可启用. 从快捷栏装备后瞄准射击.
目光锐利

UI_trait_LastStandDesc.en: Explode in a last stand of defiance when about to be dragged down.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.ch: 即將被拖倒時, 以最後的反抗引爆自身.
UI_trait_LastStandDesc.cn: 即将被拖倒时, 以最后的反抗引爆自身.

UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.en:
One punch. Everything dies.
Obliterate doors, trees, zombies, and zombie hordes with a single unarmed strike.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.ch:
一拳. 萬物皆滅.
徒手一擊即可粉碎門扉, 樹木, 殭屍與整群屍潮.
UI_trait_OnePunchDesc.cn:
一拳. 万物皆灭.
徒手一击即可粉碎门扉, 树木, 僵尸与整群尸潮.

UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.en:
Start with nigh-impenetrable plot armor.
Just don't forget to equip it.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.ch:
開局即擁有幾乎無法穿透的主角光環.
只是別忘了把它裝備上.
UI_trait_PlotArmorDesc.cn:
开局即拥有几乎无法穿透的主角光环.
只是别忘了把它装备上.

UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.en:
Violence is a part of you now.
Increased boredom.
Boost mood with every kill.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.ch:
暴力已成為你的一部分.
更容易感到無聊.
每次擊殺都能提振心情.
UI_trait_PsychoticDesc.cn:
暴力已成为你的一部分.
更容易感到无聊.
每次击杀都能提振心情.

UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.en:
Wounds heal in minutes.
Never become diseased or infected.
Immune to zombification.
Fast Healer
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.ch:
傷口幾分鐘就癒合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫殭屍化.
快速恢復
UI_trait_RegenerationDesc.cn:
伤口几分钟就愈合.
永不生病或感染.
免疫僵尸化.
快速恢复

UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.en:
Passively push zombies away with telekinetic shields.
Shout to project devastating telekinetic blasts.
Drains endurance; will fail if you get too tired.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.ch:
被動以念力護盾推開殭屍.
大喊即可發出毀滅性的念力衝擊波.
會消耗耐力; 太過疲勞時將會失敗.
UI_trait_TelekinesisDesc.cn:
被动以念力护盾推开僵尸.
大喊即可发出毁灭性的念力冲击波.
会消耗耐力; 太过疲劳时将会失败.

UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.en:
Shout to summon the wrath of the heavens.
Only works outside.
Beware of fires!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.ch:
大喊即可召喚天罰.
僅能在室外使用.
小心引發火災!
UI_trait_ThunderstrikeDesc.cn:
大喊即可召唤天罚.
仅能在室外使用.
小心引发火灾!

UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.en:
Sprint straight through your enemies. They will regret it.
Just don't run out of endurance in the middle of a horde.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.ch:
直接衝過敵人. 他們會後悔的.
只是別在屍潮中間耗盡耐力.
UI_trait_UnstoppableDesc.cn:
直接冲过敌人. 他们会后悔的.
只是别在尸潮中间耗尽耐力.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.en: It feels your fear, and hates it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.ch: 它感受到你的恐懼, 並為此憎惡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Anxious_Desc.cn: 它感受到你的恐惧, 并为此憎恶.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.en: Just a tool. Nothing has marked it.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.ch: 不過是件工具. 還沒有任何事物在它身上留下痕跡.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Cold_Desc.cn: 不过是件工具. 还没有任何事物在它身上留下痕迹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.en: Rain and red run together. Nothing sticks.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.ch: 雨水與血色一同流下. 什麼也沾不住.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Damp_Desc.cn: 雨水与血色一同流下. 什么也沾不住.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.en: Late and still. It dreams of edges it has met.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.ch: 夜深而靜. 它夢見自己交手過的每一道鋒刃.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dreaming_Desc.cn: 夜深而静. 它梦见自己交手过的每一道锋刃.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.en: It won't come clean. It doesn't try.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.ch: 它擦不乾淨. 它也不打算擦.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Dripping_Desc.cn: 它擦不干净. 它也不打算擦.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.en: Idle and indoors. It dozes against your side.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.ch: 閒置於室內. 它靠在你身側打盹.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Drowsing_Desc.cn: 闲置于室内. 它靠在你身侧打盹.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.en: Blooded in the dark. It pulls toward the next one.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中飲過血. 它拉扯著奔向下一個.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Feral_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中饮过血. 它拉扯着奔向下一个.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.en: Your dread strikes a spark in it, then nothing.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.ch: 你的恐懼在它體內擦出一星火花, 隨即歸於虛無.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Flickering_Desc.cn: 你的恐惧在它体内擦出一星火花, 随即归于虚无.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.en: The light goes. It feels the long dark coming on.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.ch: 天光將盡. 它感覺到漫長的黑暗正在逼近.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gloaming_Desc.cn: 天光将尽. 它感觉到漫长的黑暗正在逼近.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.en: Slick to the grip and full — and hungry anyway.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.ch: 握柄濕滑, 已然飽足——卻依舊飢渴.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Gorged_Desc.cn: 握柄湿滑, 已然饱足——却依旧饥渴.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.en: Grey at the edges — you've lasted the night. It eases.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.ch: 天邊泛起灰白——你熬過了這一夜. 它鬆弛下來.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Greying_Desc.cn: 天边泛起灰白——你熬过了这一夜. 它松弛下来.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.en: Quiet warmth in the daylight. Content, briefly.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.ch: 日光下靜靜地溫著. 短暫地心滿意足.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Humming_Desc.cn: 日光下静静地温着. 短暂地心满意足.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.en: Half-fed in the dark, casting for more.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中半飽, 仍四處搜尋著下一口.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Hunting_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中半饱, 仍四处搜寻着下一口.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.en: No voice in it — only the weight of the dead.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.ch: 它體內沒有聲音——只有亡者的重量.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Quiet_Desc.cn: 它体内没有声音——只有亡者的重量.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.en: Quiet — but it counts the dead it has made.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.ch: 靜默——但它清點著自己造就的亡者.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Remembering_Desc.cn: 静默——但它清点着自己造就的亡者.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.en: It won't settle. It paces in your hand.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.ch: 它靜不下來. 在你手中來回踱步.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Restless_Desc.cn: 它静不下来. 在你手中来回踱步.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.en: The rain takes the blood. It lets go, for now.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.ch: 雨水帶走血跡. 它暫時鬆手了.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Rinsing_Desc.cn: 雨水带走血迹. 它暂时松手了.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.en: Awake to the work now. It wants the rhythm to hold.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.ch: 它已為這場活計醒來. 它想讓這節奏持續下去.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Roused_Desc.cn: 它已为这场活计醒来. 它想让这节奏持续下去.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.en: Clean and sheltered, it forgets what it saw.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.ch: 潔淨而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看過什麼.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Settling_Desc.cn: 洁净而有遮蔽, 它忘了自己看过什么.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.en: It rings between every blow. It does not want to stop.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.ch: 每一擊之間它都在鳴響. 它不想停下.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Singing_Desc.cn: 每一击之间它都在鸣响. 它不想停下.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.en: Resting. Patient. It has all the time there is.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.ch: 歇息. 耐心. 它擁有世上全部的時間.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Still_Desc.cn: 歇息. 耐心. 它拥有世上全部的时间.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.en: Heavier than it was. It blames your tired arm.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.ch: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲憊的手臂.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Straining_Desc.cn: 比先前更沉了. 它怪罪你疲惫的手臂.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.en: Clean under a dead sky. It wants that to change.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.ch: 在死寂的天空下潔淨無染. 它想改變這一點.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Thirsting_Desc.cn: 在死寂的天空下洁净无染. 它想改变这一点.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.en: Too much death, too fast — it shudders to keep up.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.ch: 死亡太多, 太快——它顫抖著才勉強跟上.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Trembling_Desc.cn: 死亡太多, 太快——它颤抖着才勉强跟上.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.en: The dark leans in. It almost understands why.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.ch: 黑暗傾身逼近. 它幾乎明白了緣由.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Uneasy_Desc.cn: 黑暗倾身逼近. 它几乎明白了缘由.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.en: The blood leaves a warmth it can't name.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.ch: 血留下一種它無法名狀的溫熱.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Warm_Desc.cn: 血留下一种它无法名状的温热.

UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.en: Awake in the dark, listening with you.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.ch: 在黑暗中醒著, 與你一同傾聽.
UI_VorpallySauced_Mood_Watchful_Desc.cn: 在黑暗中醒着, 与你一同倾听.

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL.en: Double-click food eats the whole item

UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.en: When enabled, double-clicking food uses the vanilla behavior and eats the whole item instead of smart partial eating.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.ch: 啟用後, 雙擊食物將採用原版行為, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智慧分次進食.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT.cn: 启用后, 双击食物将采用原版行为, 直接吃掉整份, 而非智能分次进食.

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 搜尋: 忽略附帶種子
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 搜寻: 忽略附带种子

UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.en: Singleplayer: controlled only by Mod Options and overrides Sandbox. Multiplayer: controlled by the server Sandbox setting. When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.ch: 單人遊戲: 僅由模組選項控制, 並覆寫沙盒設定. 多人遊戲: 由伺服器沙盒設定控制. 啟用後, 搜尋找到的野生作物仍會給予食物物品, 但自動產生的額外種子物品會被忽略.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE.cn: 单人游戏: 仅由模组选项控制, 并覆盖沙盒设置. 多人游戏: 由服务器沙盒设置控制. 启用后, 搜寻找到的野生作物仍会给予食物物品, 但自动产生的额外种子物品会被忽略.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.en: Reload cleanup options are mutually exclusive: enable either dropping leftovers or deleting leftovers, never both. Deleting permanently removes the leftover item from your inventory.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.ch: 裝填清理選項互斥: 丟棄殘件與刪除殘件只能擇一啟用, 不可同時開啟. 刪除會將殘件從你的物品欄中永久移除.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_CLEANUP_W.cn: 装填清理选项互斥: 丢弃残件与删除残件只能择一启用, 不可同时开启. 删除会将残件从你的物品栏中永久移除.

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 裝填鍵: 刪除損壞殘件
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 装填键: 删除损坏残件

UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.en: Optional cleanup. Whenever a melee reload is executed by quick reload or by selecting a weapon from the hold-reload radial menu, broken melee leftovers are permanently deleted from the main inventory. This removes the leftover item from your inventory and cannot be used together with Drop Broken Leftovers.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.ch: 選用的清理功能. 每當透過快速裝填, 或從按住裝填鍵開啟的環形選單中選擇武器而執行近戰裝填時, 損壞的近戰殘件會從主物品欄中永久刪除. 此選項會將殘件從你的物品欄移除, 且不可與「丟棄損壞殘件」同時使用.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_DELETE_LE.cn: 可选的清理功能. 每当通过快速装填, 或从按住装填键打开的环形菜单中选择武器而执行近战装填时, 损坏的近战残件会从主物品栏中永久删除. 此选项会将残件从你的物品栏移除, 且不可与“丢弃损坏残件”同时使用.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.en: When enabled, combat-stance movement speed uses the selected Nimble limit only if your real Nimble level is higher. XP is not reduced.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.ch: 啟用後, 只有在你實際的靈活等級高於所選上限時, 戰鬥姿態的移動速度才會套用該上限. 經驗值不會減少.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT.cn: 启用后, 只有在你实际的灵活等级高于所选上限时, 战斗姿态的移动速度才会应用该上限. 经验值不会减少.

UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.en: Sets the maximum effective Nimble level for combat-stance movement speed. If your real Nimble level is equal or lower, nothing is changed.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.ch: 設定戰鬥姿態移動速度所採用的靈活等級上限. 若你實際的靈活等級等於或低於此值, 則不會有任何變化.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT.cn: 设定战斗姿态移动速度所采用的灵活等级上限. 若你实际的灵活等级等于或低于此值, 则不会有任何变化.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.en: Double-click traps to add best bait
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.ch: 雙擊陷阱自動放入最佳誘餌
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK.cn: 双击陷阱自动放入最佳诱饵

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.en: Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.ch: 雙擊空陷阱時, 自動從你的物品欄取用最佳的新鮮誘餌. 若該陷阱能捕捉兔子, 會優先使用兔子誘餌.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_BAIT_DBLCLICK_TT.cn: 双击空陷阱时, 自动从你的物品栏取用最佳的新鲜诱饵. 若该陷阱能捕捉兔子, 会优先使用兔子诱饵.

UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.en: After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.ch: 放置陷阱後, 若物品欄中仍有同類型陷阱, 會自動接著放置下一個.
UI_BT_OPTION_AUTO_REARM_TT.cn: 放置陷阱后, 若物品栏中仍有同类型陷阱, 会自动接着放置下一个.

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.en: Color trap highlight by bait state
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.ch: 依誘餌狀態顯示陷阱高亮顏色
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT.cn: 依诱饵状态显示陷阱高亮颜色

UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Hovered traps use different highlight colors depending on whether they are baited, empty, or sprung.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 滑鼠移過陷阱時, 會依已放餌, 空置或已觸發等狀態顯示不同的高亮顏色.
UI_BT_OPTION_COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 鼠标移过陷阱时, 会依已放饵, 空置或已触发等状态显示不同的高亮颜色.

UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.en: Continuously highlights nearby traps around you. Disabled by default for performance and visual clarity.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.ch: 持續高亮你周圍的陷阱. 為兼顧效能與畫面清晰, 預設為停用.
UI_BT_OPTION_NEARBY_HIGHLIGHT_TT.cn: 持续高亮你周围的陷阱. 为兼顾性能与画面清晰, 默认为禁用.

UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.en: Show compact body-part warmth, wind, and protection changes in wear previews.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.ch: 在穿著預覽中以精簡形式顯示各身體部位的保溫, 防風和防護變化.
UI_BCI_ShowCoverageChanges_tooltip.cn: 在穿着预览中以精简形式显示各身体部位的保温, 防风和防护变化.

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.ch: 穿著預覽需按住快捷鍵
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison.cn: 穿着预览需按住快捷键

UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.en: Only show the inventory-hover wear preview while the keybind is pressed.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.ch: 僅在按住快捷鍵時才顯示物品欄懸停的穿著預覽.
UI_BCI_UseKeybindForComparison_tooltip.cn: 仅在按住快捷键时才显示物品栏悬停的穿着预览.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.en: Controls diagnostic output for troubleshooting. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.ch: 控制用於排除問題的診斷輸出. 詳細記錄可能影響效能, 請僅在重現問題時啟用.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_DebugOutput_T.cn: 控制用于排查问题的诊断输出. 详细日志可能影响性能, 请仅在复现问题时启用.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.en: Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.ch: 將拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreDisman.cn: 将拆解物品所得的材料放回被拆解物品原本所在的容器.

UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.en: You need to quit and reload to synchronize your inventory and traits
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.ch: 你需要退出並重新載入才能同步你的物品欄與特質.
UI_Btn_CharLoad_tooltip.cn: 你需要退出并重新加载才能同步你的物品栏与特质.

UI_ClothingType_BSizeClothes.ch: 衣櫃: B 尺寸服裝
UI_ClothingType_BSizeClothes.cn: 衣柜: B 尺寸服装

Do you know what is most important in an apocalypse? style!
Start the game knowing all the clothing recipes from the Bianca Wardrobe Mod.
+1 Tailoring
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.ch:
你知道末日中最重要的是什麼嗎? 品味!
開局即掌握 Bianca 衣櫃模組的所有服裝配方.
+1 縫紉
UI_trait_FashionmancerDesc.cn:
你知道末日中最重要的是什么吗? 品味!
开局即掌握 Bianca 衣柜模组的所有服装配方.

UI_profdesc_wanderer.ch: 打造屬於你自己的故事
UI_profdesc_wanderer.cn: 打造属于你自己的故事

UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.en: Your immunity can suppress the zombie virus.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.ch: 你的免疫系統能夠壓制殭屍病毒.
UI_trait_zReAntibodiesDesc.cn: 你的免疫系统能够压制僵尸病毒.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousBar.en: The barrel could not be identified. Try clicking it again.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousBar.ch: 無法識別該桶. 請再次點選它.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousBar.cn: 无法识别该桶. 请再次点击它.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousGen.en: The generator could not be identified. Try clicking again.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousGen.ch: 無法識別該發電機. 請再次點選.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_AmbiguousGen.cn: 无法识别该发电机. 请再次点击.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelAddFai.en: The barrel could not receive the liquid.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelIdMiss.en: The barrel could not be validated.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLockLo.en: The transfer was interrupted because the barrel changed state.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLockLo.ch: 由於該桶的狀態發生變化, 轉移被中斷.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLockLo.cn: 由于该桶的状态发生变化, 转移被中断.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLocked.en: Another player is already using this barrel.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLocked.ch: 另一名玩家正在使用這個桶.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelLocked.cn: 另一名玩家正在使用这个桶.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelNotFou.en: The barrel is no longer available.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelRemove.en: The barrel could not provide the liquid.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_BarrelUnavai.en: The barrel must be open first.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ClientProgre.en: The transfer lost client sync and was stopped.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ClientProgre.ch: 轉移失去客戶端同步, 已停止.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ClientProgre.cn: 转移失去客户端同步, 已停止.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_GeneratorAdd.en: The generator could not receive the gasoline.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_GeneratorAdd.ch: 該發電機無法接收汽油.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_GeneratorAdd.cn: 该发电机无法接收汽油.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_GeneratorNot.en: The generator is no longer available.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_GeneratorReq.en: Generators can only be refueled with gasoline.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_Incompatible.en: Liquids of different types cannot be mixed.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_Incompatible.ch: 不同種類的液體不能混合.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_Incompatible.cn: 不同类型的液体不能混合.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_Insufficient.en: There is not enough water in the barrel.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_InteractionI.en: You cannot do that from this position or without the required tool.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_InteractionI.ch: 你目前所在的位置無法進行此操作, 或是缺少所需工具.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_InteractionI.cn: 你无法从当前位置或在缺少所需工具时这样做.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_InvalidPlaye.en: The player could not be validated.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_ItemMutation.en: The item could not be updated.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_MissingTrans.en: The transfer lost its network id.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_NotWashable.en: That liquid cannot be used for washing.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_NotWashable.ch: 這種液體不能用於清洗.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_NotWashable.cn: 这种液体不能用于清洗.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SameEndpoint.ch: 請選擇另一個桶作為目標.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SameEndpoint.cn: 请选择另一个桶作为目标.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceCannot.en: That container cannot pour that liquid.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceCannot.ch: 該容器不能倒出這種液體.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceCannot.cn: 该容器不能倒出这种液体.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceLiquid.en: The container has no transferable liquid.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceLiquid.ch: 該容器沒有可轉移的液體.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceLiquid.cn: 该容器没有可转移的液体.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceNotFou.en: The source container was not found.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_SourceRemove.en: The source container could not be updated.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TargetAddFai.en: The target container could not be updated.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TargetCannot.en: That container cannot receive that liquid.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TargetCannot.ch: 該容器不能接收這種液體.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TargetCannot.cn: 该容器不能接收这种液体.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TargetNotFou.en: The target container was not found.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TransferMism.en: That transfer no longer matches the server state.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TransferMism.ch: 該轉移與伺服器狀態不再相符.
UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TransferMism.cn: 该转移不再匹配服务器状态.

UI_BarrEx_TransferRejection_TransferNotA.en: That transfer is no longer active.

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.en: Return Items after Opening or Unpacking
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.ch: 開啟或拆封後歸還物品
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.cn: 打开或拆包后归还物品

UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.en: Returns items obtained by opening containers or unpacking boxes to their original container. Leftovers and empty containers produced by opening and eating are returned regardless of this setting.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.ch: 將開啟容器或拆封箱盒所得的物品放回原本的容器. 開啟並食用所產生的剩料與空容器不受此設定影響, 一律歸還.
UI_P4TidyUpMeister_Options_RestoreOpenin.cn: 将打开容器或拆包箱盒所得的物品放回原来的容器. 打开并食用所产生的剩料与空容器不受此设置影响, 一律归还.

UI_DRJ_Options_showXPWindow_tooltip.en: Shows a movable XP bar and XP drops. <LINE>Multiplayer XP logging remains active when this is disabled.
UI_DRJ_Options_showXPWindow_tooltip.ch: 顯示可移動的經驗值條與經驗值飄字. <LINE>停用時, 多人遊戲的經驗值紀錄仍會持續運作.
UI_DRJ_Options_showXPWindow_tooltip.cn: 显示可移动的经验值条与经验值飘字. <LINE>禁用时, 多人游戏的经验值记录仍会持续运行.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_AllThumbs_Bonu.en: Thief: Decreases stealing success chance and maximum item weight, and increases fumble chance.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_AllThumbs_Bonu.ch: 盜賊: 降低偷竊成功率與可偷竊物品的重量上限, 並提高失誤機率.
UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_AllThumbs_Bonu.cn: 盗贼: 降低偷窃成功率和可偷窃物品的重量上限, 并提高失误概率.

UI_P4ThiefExpansion_Trait_Clumsy_Bonus.en: Thief: Greatly decreases the duration of stealth.

UI_trait_slowpoke._note: issue #125：MoreTraits - Dynamic 的 MoreTraits - Dynamic.lua:284（有效分支 42.17，該檔無任何 Lua 長註解，確認為活程式碼）在移除 gimp 特質時以 getText("UI_trait_slowpoke") 顯示 halo 文字，但該鍵未定義於任何檔、任何語言。上游 EN 的 UI_trait_gimp 即為 "Slowpoke"，可判定作者誤植鍵名，故值與 UI_trait_gimp 一致（磨磨蹭蹭），非自行造詞。【同批已撤】UI_trait_lightdrink/harddrink(+desc) 曾一併登記，後查出唯一 producer MoreTraitsMainCreationMethods.lua:413-414 位於該檔第 1 行 --[[ 至第 426 行 --]] 的整檔註解內、永不執行，且 ToadTraits.txt 未以 character_trait_definition 補回，屬死鍵故移除。教訓：以 regex 掃 getText( 判定活引用時必須先排除 Lua 註解區塊。

UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliageFed.en: The sugar water you poured in is covering the shortfall for now.

UI_HCB_GH_TipFoliageFed.cn: 你倒入的糖水暂时补足了缺口.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyYeast.en: Wait until the current batch is done before changing the yeast.

UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerEmpty.en: The smoker is out of fuel.

UI_HCB_MB_SayUnpause.en: Unpause the game to work the barrel.

UI_HCB_MB_SayUnpause.cn: 取消游戏暂停才能操作发酵桶.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.en: A new queen is growing - ready in about %1h.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.ch: 新的蜂后正在成長 - 大約 %1h 後完成.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQLBrooding.cn: 新的蜂后正在成长 - 大约 %1h 后完成.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBeeTake.en: Click to take her - live bees make good fishing bait.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBeeTake.ch: 點選以取出她 - 活蜜蜂是不錯的魚餌.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBeeTake.cn: 点击以取出她 - 活蜜蜂是不错的鱼饵.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.en: Yeast: %1 uses of a Yeast packet, or a Wild Yeast Culture.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.ch: 酵母: 酵母包的 %1 次用量, 或一份野生酵母培養物.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1c.cn: 酵母: 酵母包的 %1 次用量, 或一份野生酵母培养物.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutNextComb.ch: 週期進度: %1h / 共 %2h, 速度 %3%%.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutNextComb.cn: 周期进度: %1h / 共 %2h, 速度 %3%%.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCombs.en: Filled honeycombs stored in the hive: %1 of %2.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.en: Add more %1 to keep this batch on one fruit profile.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.ch: 再加入更多 %1, 讓這一批維持單一水果風味.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSameFruit.cn: 再加入更多 %1, 让这一批维持单一水果风味.

UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.en: %1 more fruit (or empty the barrel and brew plain)
UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.ch: 還需要 %1 水果 (或清空發酵桶, 改釀原味)
UI_HCB_MB_NeedFruit.cn: 还需要 %1 水果 (或清空发酵桶, 改酿原味)

UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonRates.en: At full speed a new comb fills about every %1 hours, and the hive stores up to %2 combs and %3 larvae.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonRates.cn: 全速运行时, 大约每 %1 小时会填满一块新蜂巢; 蜂箱最多可储存 %2 块蜂巢和 %3 只幼虫.

UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.en: You have a cage ready - click her to remove her now.

UI_HCB_GH_TipQueenClickCage.cn: 你已经备好蜂后笼 - 点击她就能立刻取出.

UI_HCB_Hive_DebugAdvanced.ch: 蜂箱時間已推進 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_Hive_DebugAdvanced.cn: 蜂箱时间已推进 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.en: Honey: %1. Click the Honey row to pour from what you carry, or drop one container on it. Bottles of honey work; you keep the glass.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.ch: 蜂蜜: %1. 點選蜂蜜那一列, 就能從身上攜帶的容器倒入, 或把單一容器拖放到上面. 瓶裝蜂蜜也可以; 玻璃瓶會留給你.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1a.cn: 蜂蜜: %1. 点击蜂蜜那一行, 就能从身上携带的容器倒入, 或把单一容器拖放到上面. 瓶装蜂蜜也可以; 玻璃瓶会留给你.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.en: It is full right now - another jar would not fit.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.ch: 目前已經滿了 - 再一罐也裝不下.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyFull.cn: 当前已经满了 - 再一罐也装不下.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.en: Storage is full - harvest to make room.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.ch: 儲存空間已滿 - 採收以騰出空間.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFull.cn: 储存空间已满 - 采收以腾出空间.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.en: Brood cell. These larvae hatch into worker bees.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.ch: 育蟲巢房. 這些幼蟲會孵化成工蜂.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBrood.cn: 育虫巢房. 这些幼虫会孵化成工蜂.

UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.en: Heavy fog is slowing the bees.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.ch: 濃霧正在減慢蜜蜂的速度.
UI_HCB_GH_CondFog.cn: 浓雾正在减慢蜜蜂的速度.

UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.en: Added fruit to the barrel. Staged fruit: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.ch: 已將水果加入發酵桶. 已投入水果: %1.
UI_HCB_MB_SayAddedFruit.cn: 已将水果加入发酵桶. 已投入水果: %1.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.en: While any is left it stands in for flowers when forage is thin.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.ch: 只要還有剩, 蜜源稀少時它就會代替花朵.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply2.cn: 只要还有剩, 蜜源稀少时它就会代替花朵.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.en: The mead could not be bottled, so nothing was used.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.ch: 蜂蜜酒無法裝瓶, 因此沒有消耗任何材料.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottlingFailed.cn: 蜂蜜酒无法装瓶, 因此没有消耗任何材料.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.en: It comes out sealed at the stage it was poured. Sealed mead never ages or spoils.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.ch: 產出時會密封在裝瓶當下的階段. 密封蜂蜜酒永遠不會繼續熟成或變質.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3c.cn: 产出时会密封在装瓶当下的阶段. 密封蜂蜜酒永远不会继续熟成或变质.

UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.en: That fruit could not be removed from inventory.
UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.ch: 無法從物品欄移除那個水果.
UI_HCB_MB_SayFruitStuck.cn: 无法从物品栏移除那个水果.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSyrupWorking.en: Sugar water is standing in for the flowers.

UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.en: That container has no honey left.
UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.ch: 那個容器裡沒有蜂蜜了.
UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoHoney.cn: 那个容器里没有蜂蜜了.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.en: There's no mead recipe for that fruit.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.ch: 那種水果沒有對應的蜂蜜酒配方.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFruitRecipe.cn: 那种水果没有对应的蜂蜜酒配方.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.en: The queen. About %1h of laying left. Use Remove Queen to cage her.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.ch: 蜂后. 大約還剩 %1h 的產卵時間. 使用「取出蜂后」把她裝籠.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellQueenHours.cn: 蜂后. 大约还剩 %1h 的产卵时间. 使用“取出蜂后”把她装笼.

UI_HCB_GH_CondKeeperBoon.ch: 你的養蜂人手藝正在發揮作用.
UI_HCB_GH_CondKeeperBoon.cn: 你的养蜂人手艺正在发挥作用.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.en: Young mead now - fully fermented in %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.ch: 目前是新酒 - %1 後完全發酵.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineYoung.cn: 当前是新酒 - %1 后完全发酵.

UI_HCB_MB_TipReadyBottleSealed.en: Click to bottle one %1 (%2 a bottle).

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.en: You need a cork or a wax cork to seal the bottle.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.ch: 你需要一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞來密封瓶子.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedSeal.cn: 你需要一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞来密封瓶子.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.en: You need a container with honey.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.ch: 你需要一個裝有蜂蜜的容器.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedHoney.cn: 你需要一个装有蜂蜜的容器.

UI_HCB_MB_SayDrawFailedSealed.en: The barrel poured a bottle, but you no longer had an empty bottle and a seal for it.

UI_HCB_MB_SayDrawFailedSealed.cn: 发酵桶倒出了一瓶, 但你已经没有空瓶和瓶塞可以装了.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.en: Sugar water left on the ground beside a working hive gets drunk too - the bees come out and empty it over the next few hours.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow4.cn: 放在运行中蜂箱旁地上的糖水也会被喝掉 - 蜜蜂会飞出来, 在接下来几小时内把它喝完.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodSmoked.en: Smoke calms the bees for about %1h and stops work on the comb. Safe to harvest.

UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.en: Bottles of honey work too - you keep the glass.

UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney3.cn: 瓶装蜂蜜也可以 - 玻璃瓶会留给你.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutLarvae.en: Larvae and bees grow with the same daily cycle as comb.

UI_HCB_MB_TipNextBottle.ch: 下一瓶還要 %1 才會完成.
UI_HCB_MB_TipNextBottle.cn: 下一瓶还要 %1 才会完成.

UI_HCB_MB_TipStartMissing.en: Fill every row first. Still needed: %1.

UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterSplash.en: Poured in a splash of sugar water - barely enough to wet the tank.

UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterSplash.cn: 倒入了一点糖水 - 勉强只够沾湿槽底.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.en: Start Wild Yeast Culture from a jar of honey or sugar water. Two days later, harvest it for a Yeast packet.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5a.ch: 用一罐蜂蜜或糖水開始培養野生酵母培養物. 兩天後採收, 就能得到一包酵母.

UI_HCB_MB_SayContainerNoWater.en: That container has no water left.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStored.en: %1 - ready to bottle. It keeps as it is until you take it.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStored.ch: %1 - 已可裝瓶. 在你取出之前會維持現狀.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStored.cn: %1 - 已可装瓶. 在你取出之前会维持现状.

UI_HCB_MB_TipWater1.en: Click to pour water from everything you carry, or drop one container to pour just that.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater1.ch: 點選以從身上所有容器倒水, 或拖放單一容器只倒那一個.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater1.cn: 点击以从身上所有容器倒水, 或拖放单一容器只倒那一个.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSmoked.en: Smoke has stopped work on the comb.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.en: Empty comb. The bees build here as the colony grows.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.ch: 空蜂巢. 隨著蜂群成長, 蜜蜂會在這裡築巢.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellEmpty.cn: 空蜂巢. 随着蜂群成长, 蜜蜂会在这里筑巢.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.en: A half-built comb. The bees will not touch it until the smoke clears.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.ch: 一塊蓋了一半的蜂巢. 煙霧散去前蜜蜂不會去動它.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingSmoked.cn: 一块盖了一半的蜂巢. 烟雾散去前蜜蜂不会去动它.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStages.en: Once a batch starts, its timeline shows here: young, fully fermented, aged, then spoiled.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineStages.cn: 批次开始后, 时间轴会显示在这里: 新酒, 完全发酵, 熟成, 最后变质.

UI_HCB_GH_OutRJProducing.ch: 蜂王乳正在形成 - 大約還要 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJProducing.cn: 蜂王浆正在形成 - 大约还要 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.en: You need a container with water.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.ch: 你需要一個裝著水的容器.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedWater.cn: 你需要一个装着水的容器.

UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.en: Unpause the game to work the hive.
UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.ch: 取消遊戲暫停後才能操作蜂箱.
UI_HCB_Hive_PausedNoInteract.cn: 取消游戏暂停后才能操作蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TipOutQueen.ch: 產卵時間剩下正好 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_TipOutQueen.cn: 产卵时间剩下正好 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.en: The hive's sugar water is full - %1 litres of it. The bees have to drink some down first.
UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.ch: 蜂箱的糖水已滿 - 共 %1 公升. 得先讓蜜蜂喝掉一些.
UI_HCB_Hive_FeedTankFull.cn: 蜂箱的糖水已满 - 共 %1 升. 得先让蜜蜂喝掉一些.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1e.en: Start Fermenting unlocks when every row is full. Every batch is %1 bottles.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.ch: 每瓶需要一個空玻璃瓶, 外加一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞 (2 個蜂蠟碎塊).
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3a.cn: 每瓶需要一个空玻璃瓶, 外加一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞 (2 个蜂蜡碎块).

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.en: The batch's timeline shows here once it starts.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.ch: 批次開始後, 它的時間軸會顯示在這裡.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineIdle1.cn: 批次开始后, 它的时间轴会显示在这里.

UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.en: Optional. %1 of one kind of fruit flavors the batch - or none for plain mead.
UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.ch: 選用. 加入 %1 的單一種水果可為批次調味 - 不加則是原味蜂蜜酒.
UI_HCB_MB_TipFruit1.cn: 可选. 加入 %1 的单一种水果可为批次调味 - 不加则是原味蜂蜜酒.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyFull.en: The honey side is already full.

UI_HCB_GH_SkyRule1.ch: 下雨和下雪會讓工作暫停.
UI_HCB_GH_SkyRule1.cn: 下雨和下雪会让工作暂停.

UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.en: No queen - nothing new is being made.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.ch: 沒有蜂后 - 不會產出任何新東西.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNoQueen.cn: 没有蜂后 - 不会产出任何新东西.

UI_HCB_Hive_SmokerOutOfFuel.en: Your Bee Smoker is out of fuel. Refuel it and light it again.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnInsertQueenTip.cn: 从物品栏放入蜂后或笼中的蜂后来启动蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.en: You are not carrying any sugar water.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.ch: 你身上沒有帶任何糖水.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyNoJar.cn: 你身上没有带任何糖水.

UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.en: Royal jelly is ready - click its cell to collect.
UI_HCB_GH_OutRJReady.ch: 蜂王乳已經完成 - 點選它的格子來收取.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBroodTake.ch: 點選以取走 - 幼蟲是不錯的釣餌.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyPartial.en: There is only room for %1 more litres - that is all this pour will take.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyPartial.ch: 只剩下 %1 公升的空間 - 這次只會倒進這麼多.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplyPartial.cn: 只剩下 %1 升的空间 - 这次只会倒进这么多.

UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.en: Calm the bees so you can work the comb safely. Burns a fifth of the smoker's fuel, and the hive stops building while the smoke lasts.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.ch: 鎮靜蜜蜂, 讓你可以安全地處理蜂巢. 會燒掉燻煙器五分之一的燃料, 而且煙霧持續期間蜂箱會停止建造.
UI_HCB_GH_BtnSmokeTip.cn: 镇静蜜蜂, 让你可以安全地处理蜂巢. 会烧掉熏烟器五分之一的燃料, 而且烟雾持续期间蜂箱会停止建造.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeBad.en: This biome is hard on bees - it slows the hive.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeBad.ch: 這種生態環境對蜜蜂很不友善 - 會拖慢蜂箱.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeBad.cn: 这种生态环境对蜜蜂很不友善 - 会拖慢蜂箱.

UI_HCB_GH_TempRule2.ch: 拖慢蜜蜂. 嚴寒會讓
UI_HCB_GH_TempRule2.cn: 拖慢蜜蜂. 严寒会让

UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney1.en: Click to pour honey from everything you carry, or drop one container to pour just that.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney1.ch: 點選可倒出你身上所有的蜂蜜, 或拖入單一容器只倒那一個.
UI_HCB_MB_TipHoney1.cn: 点击可倒出你身上所有的蜂蜜, 或拖入单一容器只倒那一个.

UI_HCB_GH_OutWeatherPaused.en: Work is paused by the weather.

UI_HCB_GH_OutHibernating.en: The hive is hibernating until it warms up.
UI_HCB_GH_OutHibernating.ch: 蜂箱正在冬眠, 直到天氣回暖.
UI_HCB_GH_OutHibernating.cn: 蜂箱正在冬眠, 直到天气回暖.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineFerment2.en: About %1 alcohol now, %2 fully fermented, %3 aged.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineFerment2.ch: 目前酒精約 %1, %2 後完全發酵, %3 後熟成.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineFerment2.cn: 当前酒精约 %1, %2 后完全发酵, %3 后熟成.

UI_HCB_MB_SayLoadedWaterItem.en: Loaded water from that container into the barrel.
UI_HCB_MB_SayLoadedWaterItem.ch: 已將那個容器裡的水倒入桶中.
UI_HCB_MB_SayLoadedWaterItem.cn: 已将那个容器里的水倒入桶中.

UI_HCB_GH_OutNextComb.ch: 下一塊蜂巢大約還要 %1 小時完成.
UI_HCB_GH_OutNextComb.cn: 下一块蜂巢大约还要 %1 小时完成.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.en: Or leave a jar of honey or sugar water on the ground: it sours into a starter by itself, unless a hive is close enough to drink it.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.ch: 或者把一罐蜂蜜或糖水放在地上: 它會自己酸化成酵母引子, 除非附近有蜂箱近到會把它喝掉.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S5b.cn: 或者把一罐蜂蜜或糖水放在地上: 它会自己酸化成酵母引子, 除非附近有蜂箱近到会把它喝掉.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.en: The temperature is off - work is a little slower.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.ch: 溫度不太對 - 工作稍微慢了一些.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSuboptimal.cn: 温度不太对 - 工作稍微慢了一些.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.en: Still fermenting - first bottle ready in %1.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.ch: 還在發酵 - 第一瓶還要 %1 才能取出.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleFillingSealed.cn: 还在发酵 - 第一瓶还要 %1 才能取出.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.en: What moves this number: rain or snow stops all work, heavy fog slows it, freezing sends the hive into hibernation, and harsh heat wears the bees down.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.ch: 影響這個數字的因素: 下雨或下雪會停下所有工作, 濃霧會拖慢速度, 嚴寒會讓蜂箱進入冬眠, 酷熱則會消耗蜜蜂的體力.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow1.cn: 影响这个数字的因素: 下雨或下雪会停下所有工作, 浓雾会拖慢速度, 严寒会让蜂箱进入冬眠, 酷热则会消耗蜜蜂的体力.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenMissing.en: There is no queen in the hive.

UI_HCB_MB_SayWaterFull.en: The water side is already full.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.en: Take one bottle out. Costs an empty glass bottle and a cork or wax cork.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.ch: 取出一瓶. 需要一個空玻璃瓶, 以及一個軟木塞或蜂蠟塞.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed1.cn: 取出一瓶. 需要一个空玻璃瓶, 以及一个软木塞或蜂蜡塞.

UI_HCB_MB_TipEmptyCell.ch: 批次發酵時會慢慢填滿.
UI_HCB_MB_TipEmptyCell.cn: 批次发酵时会慢慢填满.

UI_HCB_GH_BeeVisualsOff.ch: 蜜蜂特效: 關閉 (點選以啟用)
UI_HCB_GH_BeeVisualsOff.cn: 蜜蜂特效: 关闭 (点击以启用)

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyWater.en: Bottle or finish the current batch before adding more water.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyWater.ch: 先把目前的批次裝瓶或處理完, 再加更多水.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyWater.cn: 先把当前的批次装瓶或处理完, 再加更多水.

UI_HCB_GH_TipLarvae.en: Larvae being raised: %1 of %2. Larvae hatch into worker bees.
UI_HCB_GH_TipLarvae.ch: 正在培育的幼蟲: %1 / %2. 幼蟲會孵化成工蜂.
UI_HCB_GH_TipLarvae.cn: 正在培育的幼虫: %1 / %2. 幼虫会孵化成工蜂.

UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.en: This barrel only stages one fruit profile at a time.
UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.ch: 這個桶一次只能備一種水果風味.
UI_HCB_MB_SayOneFruitProfile.cn: 这个桶一次只能备一种水果风味.

UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.en: The bees are calm and busy.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.ch: 蜜蜂很平靜, 也很忙碌.
UI_HCB_GH_TipMoodWorking.cn: 蜜蜂很平静, 也很忙碌.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.en: Nothing to bottle yet. Start a batch first.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.ch: 還沒有東西可以裝瓶. 先開始一個批次.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleNoneSealed.cn: 还没有东西可以装瓶. 先开始一个批次.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineAged.ch: 已熟成且濃烈 - %1 後會變質.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineAged.cn: 已熟成且浓烈 - %1 后会变质.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.en: A neutral biome - no effect on the hive.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.ch: 中性的生態環境 - 對蜂箱沒有影響.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBiomeNeutral.cn: 中性的生态环境 - 对蜂箱没有影响.

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.en: Abundant plant life and current biome are boosting your harvest.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.ch: 茂盛的植被和目前的生態環境都在提升你的收成.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBoth.cn: 茂盛的植被和当前的生态环境都在提升你的收获.

UI_HCB_GH_CondSnow.ch: 下雪讓所有工作都暫停了.
UI_HCB_GH_CondSnow.cn: 下雪让所有工作都暂停了.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.en: There is not enough room left for a whole bottle of honey.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.ch: 剩下的空間不夠放一整瓶蜂蜜.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyBottleNoRoom.cn: 剩下的空间不够放一整瓶蜂蜜.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.en: The bees are building this comb. About %1h until it is full.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.ch: 蜜蜂正在建造這塊蜂巢. 大約還要 %1 小時才會填滿.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellGrowingEta.cn: 蜜蜂正在建造这块蜂巢. 大约还要 %1 小时才会填满.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonNow.en: %1 is the current month. A queen lays for about %2 days before she needs replacing.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonNow.ch: 目前的月份是 %1. 蜂后大約可以產卵 %2 天, 之後就需要更換.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSeasonNow.cn: 当前月份是 %1. 蜂后大约可以产卵 %2 天, 之后就需要更换.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFullDraw.en: This batch has not produced a full 1.0 L draw yet.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFullDraw.ch: 這個批次還沒產出滿 1.0 公升可取用的量.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoFullDraw.cn: 这个批次还没产出满 1.0 升可取用的量.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply4.en: Click to pour in a jar. Jars left beside the hive get drunk too.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply4.ch: 點選可倒入一罐. 放在蜂箱旁邊的罐子也會被喝掉.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupply4.cn: 点击可倒入一罐. 放在蜂箱旁边的罐子也会被喝掉.

UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.en: Start the batch: %1 bottles from %2 honey, %3 water,
UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.ch: 開始批次: %1 瓶, 需要 %2 蜂蜜, %3 水,
UI_HCB_MB_TipStart1.cn: 开始批次: %1 瓶, 需要 %2 蜂蜜, %3 水,

UI_HCB_MB_TimelinePrime.en: In its prime. Stronger if you wait, riskier too.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelinePrime.ch: 正值最佳狀態. 再等會更濃烈, 但風險也更高.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelinePrime.cn: 正值最佳状态. 再等会更浓烈, 但风险也更高.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedEmptyBottle.en: You need an empty glass bottle to fill.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedEmptyBottle.ch: 你需要一個空玻璃瓶來裝.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNeedEmptyBottle.cn: 你需要一个空玻璃瓶来装.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1b.ch: 水: %1, 用同樣的方式加入.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1b.cn: 水: %1, 用同样的方式加入.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2c.en: Bottle early for Young mead, on time for the classic, late for stronger Aged. Left past Aged it spoils - throw it out with the button.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2c.ch: 早點裝瓶可得到新酒, 準時裝瓶是經典風味, 晚一點裝瓶則是更烈的熟成款. 過了熟成期還放著就會變質 - 用按鈕把它倒掉.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2c.cn: 早点装瓶可得到新酒, 准时装瓶是经典风味, 晚一点装瓶则是更烈的熟成款. 过了熟成期还放着就会变质 - 用按钮把它倒掉.

UI_HCB_GH_TipBees.en: Honeybees living in the hive: %1 of %2. They grow with each cycle.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBees.ch: 住在蜂箱裡的蜜蜂: %1 / %2. 每個週期都會增加.
UI_HCB_GH_TipBees.cn: 住在蜂箱里的蜜蜂: %1 / %2. 每个周期都会增加.

UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplySplash.en: There is barely a splash of room left - that is all this pour will take.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplySplash.ch: 只剩下一點點空間 - 這次只會倒進這麼多.
UI_HCB_GH_TipSupplySplash.cn: 只剩下一点点空间 - 这次只会倒进这么多.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenDays.en: The queen is laying well - %1 days left.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenDays.ch: 蜂后產卵狀況良好 - 還剩 %1 天.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenDays.cn: 蜂后产卵状况良好 - 还剩 %1 天.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4b.en: An empty mead bottle is a plain glass bottle again.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4b.ch: 喝完的蜂蜜酒瓶又會變回普通玻璃瓶.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S4b.cn: 喝完的蜂蜜酒瓶又会变回普通玻璃瓶.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3b.en: Click a full bottle in the tray, or press Bottle Mead.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3b.ch: 點選托盤裡裝滿的瓶子, 或按下裝瓶蜂蜜酒.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S3b.cn: 点击托盘里装满的瓶子, 或按下装瓶蜂蜜酒.

UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenHours.en: The queen is old - about %1h left.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenHours.ch: 蜂后已經老了 - 大約還剩 %1 小時.
UI_HCB_GH_OutQueenHours.cn: 蜂后已经老了 - 大约还剩 %1 小时.

UI_HCB_GH_SeasonCaption.en: green = queen season (wild queens can be foraged)
UI_HCB_GH_SeasonCaption.ch: 綠色 = 蜂后季節 (可以採集到野生蜂后)
UI_HCB_GH_SeasonCaption.cn: 绿色 = 蜂后季节 (可以采集到野生蜂后)

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1d.en: Fruit (optional): %1 of one kind for a flavored batch, or none for plain.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1d.ch: 水果 (選用): 加入 %1 的單一種水果做成調味批次, 不加則是原味.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S1d.cn: 水果 (可选): 加入 %1 的单一种水果做成调味批次, 不加则是原味.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleFirst.en: Bottle the ready mead before starting another batch.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleFirst.ch: 先把已完成的蜂蜜酒裝瓶, 再開始下一個批次.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBottleFirst.cn: 先把已完成的蜂蜜酒装瓶, 再开始下一个批次.

UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyToppedOff.en: Topped the honey off. The part-used bottle keeps the rest.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyToppedOff.ch: 蜂蜜已加滿. 用了一部分的瓶子會留著剩下的.
UI_HCB_MB_SayHoneyToppedOff.cn: 蜂蜜已加满. 用了一部分的瓶子会留着剩下的.

UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterPoured.en: Poured in %1 litres of sugar water. The hive is holding %2 litres now.
UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterPoured.ch: 倒入了 %1 公升糖水. 蜂箱現在存有 %2 公升.
UI_HCB_Hive_FedSugarWaterPoured.cn: 倒入了 %1 升糖水. 蜂箱现在存有 %2 升.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellFilled.en: Filled honeycomb - click to take one. Drink the honey, crush the empty comb into wax.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellFilled.ch: 已填滿的蜂巢 - 點選以取走一塊. 蜂蜜可以喝, 空蜂巢可以壓碎成蜂蠟.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellFilled.cn: 已填满的蜂巢 - 点击以取走一块. 蜂蜜可以喝, 空蜂巢可以压碎成蜂蜡.

UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.en: This biome is boosting your harvest.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.ch: 這種生態環境正在提升你的收成.
UI_HCB_GH_CondBoostBiome.cn: 这种生态环境正在提升你的收获.

UI_HCB_MB_TipWater2.en: A batch takes %1 of clean water.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater2.ch: 一個批次需要 %1 的乾淨水.
UI_HCB_MB_TipWater2.cn: 一个批次需要 %1 的干净水.

UI_HCB_MB_SayYeastStuck.en: That yeast could not be used.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNoDumpLive.en: You cannot dump the barrel while a live batch is fermenting.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoDumpLive.ch: 還有批次正在發酵時, 你不能倒掉桶裡的東西.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNoDumpLive.cn: 还有批次正在发酵时, 你不能倒掉桶里的东西.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBee.en: A worker bee resting on her comb.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBee.ch: 一隻工蜂停在自己的蜂巢上休息.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCellBee.cn: 一只工蜂停在自己的蜂巢上休息.

UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyHoney.en: Bottle or finish the current batch before adding more honey.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyHoney.ch: 先把目前的批次裝瓶或處理完, 再加更多蜂蜜.
UI_HCB_MB_SayBusyHoney.cn: 先把当前的批次装瓶或处理完, 再加更多蜂蜜.

UI_HCB_MB_TimelineSpoiled.en: Spoiled. Dump it, or bottle it at your own risk.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineSpoiled.ch: 已變質. 倒掉它, 或是自行承擔風險裝瓶.
UI_HCB_MB_TimelineSpoiled.cn: 已变质. 倒掉它, 或是自行承担风险装瓶.

UI_HCB_GH_CondNoQueen.en: Without a queen, nothing new is made.
UI_HCB_GH_CondNoQueen.ch: 沒有蜂后就不會產出任何新東西.
UI_HCB_GH_CondNoQueen.cn: 没有蜂后就不会产出任何新东西.

UI_HCB_MB_TipYeast1.en: Required. A batch takes %1 uses of yeast.
UI_HCB_MB_TipYeast1.ch: 必需. 一個批次需要 %1 次用量的酵母.
UI_HCB_MB_TipYeast1.cn: 必需. 一个批次需要 %1 次用量的酵母.

UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2b.en: It keeps working while you are away.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2b.ch: 你離開時它也會繼續運作.
UI_HCB_MB_Guide_S2b.cn: 你离开时它也会继续运行.

UI_HCB_MB_SayNotEnoughStaged.en: You need enough staged honey, water, and yeast to start at least 1.0 L.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNotEnoughStaged.ch: 你備的蜂蜜, 水和酵母要夠做出至少 1.0 公升才能開始.
UI_HCB_MB_SayNotEnoughStaged.cn: 你备的蜂蜜, 水和酵母要够做出至少 1.0 升才能开始.

UI_HCB_GH_TipTakeAngers.en: The bees are working - smoke them first or taking one will anger them.
UI_HCB_GH_TipTakeAngers.ch: 蜜蜂正在工作 - 先用煙燻過牠們, 否則取走東西會惹怒牠們.
UI_HCB_GH_TipTakeAngers.cn: 蜜蜂正在工作 - 先用烟熏过它们, 否则取走东西会惹怒它们.

UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineSpoiled.en: %1 - spoiled. Dump it, or bottle it at your own risk.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineSpoiled.ch: %1 - 已變質. 倒掉它, 或是自行承擔風險裝瓶.
UI_HCB_MB_TipTimelineSpoiled.cn: %1 - 已变质. 倒掉它, 或是自行承担风险装瓶.

UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow2.en: Flowers and crops near the hive speed it up, a good biome helps, smoke calms the bees but pauses their work, and a Beekeeper's touch boosts it.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow2.ch: 蜂箱附近的花朵和作物會加快速度, 好的生態環境也有幫助, 煙霧能鎮靜蜜蜂但會讓牠們停下工作, 而養蜂人的手藝則會加成.
UI_HCB_GH_TipCondHow2.cn: 蜂箱附近的花朵和作物会加快速度, 好的生态环境也有帮助, 烟雾能镇静蜜蜂但会让它们停下工作, 而养蜂人的手艺则会加成.

UI_HCB_MB_TipStart2.ch: %1 水果和 %2 次用量的酵母.
UI_HCB_MB_TipStart2.cn: %1 水果和 %2 次用量的酵母.

UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed2.en: Sealed mead never spoils. Open it with a corkscrew or a knife.
UI_HCB_MB_TipBottleSealed2.ch: 密封的蜂蜜酒永遠不會變質. 用開瓶器或刀子打開它.

UI_OC_AlphabeticalCategorySort_tooltip._note: 2026-08-25 #276 上游刪鍵對帳：organizedCategories_core 此版已自 Translate/EN 移除 UI_OC_AlphabeticalCategorySort 與本鍵（tracker state 與 sources/en 鏡像皆已無）。裸鍵 UI_OC_AlphabeticalCategorySort 我方本來就沒有；本鍵仍在 own 層並出貨。**刻意保留而非移除**：本機未訂閱 3370707195，無法查證上游 Lua 是否仍呼叫此鍵——若仍呼叫而我方移除，玩家會看到字面鍵名（退化）；保留則最壞情況只是出貨死資料（該前綴為 organizedCategories 專屬，其他 mod 撞名風險極低）。**改判移除時的完整摘除清單**：本條目、`ch_review_state.json` 的 `UI.json|UI_OC_AlphabeticalCategorySort_tooltip` 登記，然後重跑 build。**結案所需證據**：把該 mod 載進本機 workshop 後搜 `AlphabeticalCategorySort` 與 `getText("UI_OC_AlphabeticalCategorySort_tooltip")`，確認無 Lua consumer 再移除。不適用 unshipped_keys.json——依 AGENTS.md 它只涵蓋「落點檔不可載入」與「owner 衝突無中性譯名」兩類，本案不屬任一類。

UI_trait_ActionHeroDesc.en:
